<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/v1/merchant/webhooks/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Remove a registered webhook URL. New events for this merchant
will no longer be dispatched to the deleted URL. Notifications
already queued on the broker at the moment of deletion continue
through their retry schedule until acknowledged or exhausted —
the delete does not purge in-flight deliveries.
